title: The 'Two Keepers, One Covenant' quest (picked up from Keeper Wren in Hollowbrook) asks you to carry a question to Keeper Rowan in Thornwold's Understory, but Rowan was met and fully exhausted much earlier with no forward hook planted for this later question — completing it means a long, unsignposted backtrack across two regions.
